findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "platform" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: astroway_ai_interpret_tarot, astroway_mcp_rag_search · Private data: astroway_account_status, astroway_ai_interpret_natal, astroway_webhooks_id_test · Public sink: astroway_mcp_ai_chat, astroway_mcp_ai_comparison_coach, astroway_mcp_ai_explain_aspect, astroway_mcp_ai_explain_transit, astroway_ai_interpret_element, astroway_ai_interpret_natal, astroway_ai_interpret_placement, astroway_ai_interpret_synastry, astroway_ai_interpret_tarot, astroway_ai_interpret_transits, astroway_mcp_agent_debate, astroway_mcp_multi_agent_coordinate, astroway_mcp_multi_chart_context, astroway_mcp_rag_search, astroway_mcp_streaming, astroway_mcp_tool_call_stream, astroway_stream_eclipse_incoming, astroway_stream_eclipse_totality, astroway_stream_ingress, astroway_stream_lunar_phase, astroway_stream_planetary_hour_changes, astroway_stream_positions, astroway_stream_retrograde_alerts, astroway_stream_sunrise_sunset, astroway_stream_transit_alerts, astroway_stream_void_of_course, astroway_webhooks_webhooks, astroway_webhooks_dasha_change, astroway_webhooks_eclipse_alert, astroway_webhooks_id, astroway_webhooks_id_test, astroway_webhooks_mahadasha_end, astroway_webhooks_planetary_hour_tick, astroway_webhooks_retrograde_end, astroway_webhooks_retrograde_start, astroway_webhooks_return_due, astroway_webhooks_sign_ingress, astroway_webhooks_subscribe, astroway_webhooks_transit_trigger, astroway_webhooks_void_of_course_start · Destructive: astroway_account_status, astroway_mcp_multi_agent_coordinate.
